result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make basic security and dignity the default: people would have access to safe food, decent healthcare, education, housing, and a fair chance at opportunity—not as an afterthought or reward, but as a shared foundation.

That one change would shift everything else: less desperation, less fear, more creativity, more cooperation, and more capacity to solve bigger problems.
